# Chip

## Description
A small pill for a count or a status word, on Cursor's measured `.monaco-count-badge` recipe.

source `crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs`, status `ready`.
Foundation: hand-rolled. Traps checked: trap/control-height, trap/weight-shift.

### Foundation
Not applicable: hand-rolled — the recipe is measured from Cursor's CSS into `theme.rs` constants; no registry item ships it.

## Examples
Default: a count chip in a pane header.

Real uses, 0 call sites (`rg 'widgets::chip' crates/ui-egui/src`): the canonical entry lands first; the pilot and safe-moves steps move the surfaces onto it.

Example: A count chip in a pane header. (`docs/system/examples/chip/default.rs`)

```
widgets::chip(ui, "3", widgets::ChipKind::Neutral);
```

Example: A status chip beside a section label in a card. (`docs/system/examples/chip/in-card.rs`)

```
widgets::card(ui, |ui| {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        widgets::section_label(ui, "Model");
        widgets::chip(ui, "ON", widgets::ChipKind::Accent);
    });
});
```

## Variants

### Kind
- `Neutral`: counts and quiet status. Used at 0 call sites.
- `Accent`: the on or active status. Used at 0 call sites.
- `Danger`: an error count or an error status. Used at 0 call sites.

Example: The neutral kind, a quiet count. (`docs/system/examples/chip/kind-neutral.rs`)

```
widgets::chip(ui, "12", widgets::ChipKind::Neutral);
```

Example: The accent kind, an on/active status. (`docs/system/examples/chip/kind-accent.rs`)

```
widgets::chip(ui, "ON", widgets::ChipKind::Accent);
```

Example: The danger kind, an error count. (`docs/system/examples/chip/kind-danger.rs`)

```
widgets::chip(ui, "2", widgets::ChipKind::Danger);
```

## States
| State | Trigger | What the user can do | Shown by, besides color | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rest | Always, once drawn. | Click it when the surface wires the click. | The pill fill by kind, with the label centred. | by hand |
| Hover | The pointer is over it. | Click it when the surface wires the click. | Nothing repaints; `.monaco-count-badge` has no hover rule. | by hand |
| Focused | Keyboard focus arrives by Tab. | Enter or Space clicks it. | A 1px ring just inside the 11px radius. | by hand |
| Disabled | The UI is disabled. | Nothing. | The fill and label stay, and no click is taken. | by hand |

### State precedence
- Hover and Focused: Focused wins. The ring shows while the pointer is over the pill.
- Focused and Disabled: Disabled wins. A disabled chip never takes focus.

### Motion
Not applicable: no motion — the recipes paint each state directly, and the app's Animation preference governs egui's own widgets.

## Props
Signature: `pub fn chip(ui: &mut egui::Ui, text: &str, kind: ChipKind) -> egui::Response`.
- `text`: the count or the status word; the widget translates it and draws it at 11px.
- `kind`: `ChipKind::Neutral`, `ChipKind::Accent` or `ChipKind::Danger`.

## Usage

### When to use
- A count, a state or a short status needs to sit beside a label or a row.

### When not to use
- The text runs a sentence. Use `section_label` instead.
- The text is an action the user runs. Use `button` instead.

### Rules
- `rule/chip-recipe`: When a chip is drawn, use `RADIUS_PILL` (11px), `CHIP_PAD_X` (6px), `CHIP_PAD_Y` (3px) and `FONT_CHIP` (11px), because `.monaco-count-badge` measures `border-radius:11px; font-size:11px; line-height:11px; padding:3px 6px` with an 18px floor. Evidence: measured 11px radius, 3px 6px padding and 18px floor, `.design-system/cursor/recipes.md` §7. Check: test crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs.
  - Don't: a 3px-radius box with `theme::small()` text as a count.
  - Do: `chip(ui, "3", ChipKind::Neutral)`.
- `rule/chip-kinds`: When a chip carries the action or error status, use the `accent` or `error` fill with `on_accent` text, because `.cursor-badge`'s variants fill from `button.background`, `badge.background` and `errorForeground` with their own foreground. Evidence: measured 3 fills, `.design-system/cursor/recipes.md` §7. Check: review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs.
  - Don't: `rect_filled(rect, 2.0, t.warn)` for a quiet count.
  - Do: pass `ChipKind::Accent` and let the widget fill from `Tokens::accent`.

### Content
- Not applicable: the text is the caller's; the widget draws it verbatim.

### Anti-slop
- `rule/chip-canonical`: When a surface needs a pill, call `chip` rather than painting one, because the inventory counted the same chip at radius 1, 2, 3, 6 and 8. Evidence: app 5/5 chip radii, `.design-system/boss/triage/inventory.md` §4. Check: review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs.
  - Don't: `rect_filled(r, 3.0, hover ? t.control_hover : t.control)` beside a label.
  - Do: `chip(ui, "M", ChipKind::Neutral)`.

### Limits
- Not applicable: no count or length limit; the caller keeps the text to a word or a count.

## Accessibility
Rests on the painted rect with `Sense::click()`, whose widget info gives egui a `button` node named by the text.

### Keyboard
| Key | Where focus is | Effect | Focus after | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tab | Anywhere | Moves focus to the chip. | The chip. | by hand |
| Enter, Space | The chip | Clicks it when the surface wires the click. | The chip. | by hand |

### ARIA
| Part | Role | Accessible name from | States and properties | Announced | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The pill rect | `button` | the `text` argument | `disabled` when the UI is disabled | "3, button" | by hand |

| Fill | `ChipKind::Neutral` | `Tokens::control` |
